title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer hysteresis during regional failover
author: Samir Kulkarni
description:
Motivation: During last week's regional outage we observed SLO enforcer circuit-breaker hysteresis interacting poorly with the regional failover path, causing aggressive load-shedding in healthy regions after the primary region recovered. This PR fixes the hysteresis state machine and adds a conservative warm-up path for regional failover to avoid over-shedding when replicas come back online.

Summary of changes: 
- Fix ordering bug in the hysteresis state transitions that could leave breakers 'sticky' when a region toggles between degraded/healthy.
- Add a probabilistic warm-up mode for regional failover which ramps allowed QPS over a short window instead of immediately re-admitting full traffic.
- Tighten SLO detection thresholds to reduce false positives during transient infra flaps.
- Add unit and integration tests that reproduce the race observed in production.

Testing and rollout: 
- Unit tests + integration (local canary) pass in CI.
- Deployed as a hotfix to release/1.14.0 clusters in staging and then promoted to the canary subset in us-west-2 for 1 hour before full rollout.
- Rollback plan: revert the merge to release/1.14.0 and trigger emergency config that disables warm-up mode.

References: Linear ENG-2431, ENG-2434; incident SUP-7891.

review_comments: Anita Rao (2026-02-18): I reproduced the failure locally using the test harness, good catch. Two questions: can we make the warm-up window configurable per-region and add telemetry for the ramp?

Samir Kulkarni (2026-02-18): Answered: yes, warmup_window_ms is configurable via helm values and we emit metrics slo_enforcer.warmup_progress and slo_enforcer.warmup_events. Updated chart values and added metrics emission in enforcer.go.

Samir Kulkarni (2026-02-19): Renamed to cooldown_max and added the 200ms flip test; CI flakes locally were addressed by adding a small clock mock in tests.
Priya Nair (2026-02-20): Approved after seeing integration run in staging and canary metrics look good (no over-shedding).

release_notes:
Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer hysteresis and add regional failover warm-up mode to prevent overzealous load-shedding after recoveries.
- Fix: sticky circuit-breaker state during region toggles
- Feature: probabilistic warm-up ramp for regional failover (configurable per-region)
- Tests: added integration test for failover race
Recommended: monitor slo_enforcer.warmup_events and slo_enforcer.broken_count during rollout.
backport: Consider backport to release/1.13.x if customers on that release observe similar behavior
notes_for_ops: When enabling warm-up in operator config, set warmup_window_ms conservatively (e.g., 30000ms) for large regions. The default is 15000ms. If rollback needed, toggling warmup.enabled=false will revert to previous admission behavior instantly.
